messages:
sam-ops: Quick heads-up: scheduling a late-night maintenance to perform staggered reboots + NIC microcode refresh in eu-north1 and us-west3. Window: 2025-05-11 23:30-01:30 UTC. Well do 3-node cohorts per region, with 10m canaries. No planned capacity changes beyond transient backfill.
neha-sre: Sounds good. Proposed sequence: canary node (10m) -> cohort drain (30m) -> thermal check -> proceed. If packet loss >0.5% during canary, abort.
dylan-runtime: Note on runtime: please set routing-policy to prefer warm-fallback pools in the same region for the window. Also enable kvseed on the target pools 20m prior to drain to reduce cold-start tokens.
sophie-custops: Who's the customer-impact list? I'll draft a support note and update the status page. Need to know if any high-SLA tenants have pinned instances in those host racks.
sam-ops: Affected pools: shared-eu-north, shared-us-west3. No dedicated pool interrupts. Pinned tenants: none in the identified host racks per inventory. Sophie, please post status update at 22:45 UTC.
neha-sre: Runbook excerpt:
```
# canary
kubectl drain node/canary-n1 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=60
sleep 600
curl -f http://probe.local/health || rollback
```
dylan-runtime: Cost impact estimate: backfill qps will add ~0.4% token usage for the two-hour window. Flagging billing-team to watch. If >0.8% we trigger cost-rollback.
sophie-custops: Draft blurb: "Planned rolling reboots in eu-north1 & us-west3 23:30-01:30 UTC. Some requests may route to fallback pools and see slight latency increases. No customer data will be affected." Posting at 22:45.
ops-bot: calendar event created: maintenance-eu-us-microcode-refresh (2025-05-11T23:30Z-2025-05-12T01:30Z). Reference: #INC000846000.
neha-sre: I'll post canary metrics (packet loss, tail-latency p95, queue depth) into this thread at 23:45. If metrics look clean, start cohort drains at 23:55.
sam-ops: Reminder: pre-seed KV-cache at 23:10; enable detailed tracing for 01:00-01:40 to capture post-reboot regressions.
dylan-runtime: Also add a temp autoscale reservation for 30 minutes after each cohort to smooth tail latencies. I'll coordinate with infra-costs.
sophie-custops: Noted. I'll escalate to enterprise contacts if we see >2% latency spike in p95.
sam-ops: Thanks all. Final: post at 22:45, pre-seed at 23:10, canary at 23:30, update thread with canary results at 23:45. :thumbsup:
